Generator of storage/testdata/tables-before-prefix-bloom/: a Badger directory's MANIFEST and
two Level-0 tables written by the build at c33271137 (next, 2026-11-15), the last tree whose
table builder knows no prefix rules. The tables therefore carry no bloom_prefix_rules field in
their index and no prefix hash in their filter.
TestTablesOfAnEarlierBuildAreNeverSkipped (prefix_bloom_earlier_build_test.go) reads them.

The throwaway test below was dropped into storage/ of that tree as
zz_prefix_bloom_fixture_generator_test.go and run once on a test VM, from hoardDB/:

    go test ./storage -run TestZZGenerateTablesBeforePrefixBloom -count=1 -v

It printed the directory's files (000001.sst 326 bytes, 000002.sst 239, MANIFEST 44, two
20-byte value logs, DISCARD, KEYREGISTRY, memtable-size) and MANIFEST plus the two tables as a
base64 tar, which was unpacked here. The other files are not checked in: Badger writes them
anew on open, and no value is large enough to sit in a value log.

000001.sst: the header of document "m" and its field 2 ("old"), the headers of documents "a"
            and "z", element 0 of the store field 4 of "m" ("first"), and element 0 of the
            same field of "a" and of "z".
000002.sst: field 2 of "m" ("new") without the header, and element 1 of the store ("second").

sha256:
be6ad3bf6e0616da80b4145669092429e21a9eb8acdaa8894428f8ceb1e29a1b   000001.sst
90c14c0677e1b79e5be3ef3ddad58db3a6c991a04c7ff18368e83fe2ed87d071   000002.sst
17240d8b340dd7c0891598780730a109fde4176c826bdbdd96aa6747725e1730   MANIFEST

----8<---- the throwaway test ----8<----

package storage_test

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/binary"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"hoardDB/storage"
)

// Throwaway: generates storage/testdata/tables-before-prefix-bloom/ from the tree at
// c33271137, the last one whose table builder knows no prefix rules. It opens a store as the
// node does, writes two batches with a close and reopen after each (one Level-0 table per
// batch), and prints MANIFEST and the two tables as a base64 tar between two marker lines.
//
//	go test ./storage -run TestZZGenerateTablesBeforePrefixBloom -count=1 -v
func TestZZGenerateTablesBeforePrefixBloom(t *testing.T) {
	dir := t.TempDir()
	id := func(letter byte) []byte { return []byte{storage.TagString, letter, 0x00, 0x00} }
	document := func(letter byte) []byte { return storage.Key(3, 7, 9, storage.NSDocuments, id(letter)) }
	element := func(letter byte, position uint64) []byte {
		return binary.BigEndian.AppendUint64(storage.Key(3, 7, 9, storage.NSFieldStore, id(letter), []byte{0x00, 0x04, storage.NSQueue}), position)
	}
	field := binary.BigEndian.AppendUint16(bytes.Clone(document('m')), 2)
	type pair struct{ key, value []byte }
	for _, table := range [][]pair{
		{
			{document('m'), []byte("header")}, {field, []byte("old")},
			{document('a'), []byte("low")}, {document('z'), []byte("high")},
			{element('m', 0), []byte("first")},
			{element('a', 0), []byte("low")}, {element('z', 0), []byte("high")},
		},
		{{field, []byte("new")}, {element('m', 1), []byte("second")}},
	} {
		kv, err := storage.OpenBadgerKV(dir, storage.BadgerTuning{MemTableMB: 32}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		batch := kv.NewBatch()
		for _, p := range table {
			if err := batch.Set(p.key, p.value); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		}
		if err := batch.Commit(true); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := kv.Close(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var archive bytes.Buffer
	w := tar.NewWriter(&archive)
	for _, entry := range entries {
		info, err := entry.Info()
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		fmt.Printf("FILE %s %d\n", entry.Name(), info.Size())
		if entry.Name() != "MANIFEST" && !strings.HasSuffix(entry.Name(), ".sst") {
			continue
		}
		content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dir, entry.Name()))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := w.WriteHeader(&tar.Header{Name: entry.Name(), Mode: 0o644, Size: int64(len(content))}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if _, err := w.Write(content); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if err := w.Close(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("FIXTURE-BEGIN\n%s\nFIXTURE-END\n", base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(archive.Bytes()))
}
